script_text: Cancer, the cosmos just slammed a red flag on you and it's impossible to ignore. Saturn is dragging a heavy square through your 4th House of Home and Family, stirring unresolved emotions buried deep in your water element. The Moon is forming a tense opposition to Mercury in your 10th House of Career, making communication dangerously misaligned. If you're single, a past connection resurfaces under this transit, but don't rush back in. If taken, a private conversation this afternoon will reveal what's been left unsaid. Your 2nd House of Income is receiving a rare Jupiter trine, signaling a financial opportunity or raise that lands before August. Do not make any major purchase or sign a contract right now — the Mercury-Saturn tension in your 10th House will twist the fine print against you. Subscribe so you don't miss what the outer planets are doing to your chart next week.
